The reconstructed core generated 18/19/20 negative-cash events and minimum cash ranged from about -166k to -189k. Largest regret: prior standalone ETF acceptance treated notional as deployable cash without a core cash contract. The remaining unknown is incremental ETF value after core orders, dated add-ons, and partial reductions are genuinely cash-constrained.
